title: Kabanga Lithium Project hybrid solar system
summary: Design, supply, installation, testing and commissioning of a hybrid solar PV and lithium battery system for Maamba Energy's lithium project at Kabanga.

specs.label: Scope
specs.value: Design, supply, install, test and commission

scope: PV, inverter and battery system design
Supply of PV modules, hybrid inverter and lithium batteries
challenge: Mining project sites need dependable power for offices and operations, often in locations where grid supply is limited and diesel generation is costly to run and maintain.
solution: Donmac engineered a three-phase hybrid system combining a 14.04 kWp solar array with 51.2 kWh of lithium storage, so solar energy carries the daytime load and stored energy covers the evening and outages.
outcomes: Improved power reliability for site operations
